title: HDSFNZ Scene HUD
description: Adds a lightweight character type (class, HP/EP/STAM/AMMO, equipment) for the in-fiction FC99 side-game 'Hyper Demon Strike Force Negative Zero,' plus a full-screen retro console-RPG HUD overlay that skins a scene for playing an episode. GM toggles it per-scene; it mounts for every client over the canvas viewport without blocking token selection or the sidebar.
